---
ezplan: 1
title: Kitchen Remodel
goal: Complete a full kitchen renovation within the $30k budget, including new cabinets, countertops, and updated wiring, with all required permits and inspections approved before spring.
done_when: Kitchen is fully functional, all construction work is complete, final inspection is passed, and total project costs remain within budget.
start: 2027-01-04
---

## P1: Planning and approvals
> Define scope, confirm budget, and secure required approvals before construction begins.

- [ ] T1: Finalize renovation scope and requirements (3d) @Jordan !high
  notes: Confirm cabinet layout, countertop materials, electrical requirements, and desired finishes.
- [ ] T2: Establish detailed project budget (2d) @Priya !high depends: T1
  notes: Include a 10% contingency reserve for unexpected costs.
- [ ] T3: Obtain contractor and supplier quotes (1w) @Jordan depends: T1
- [ ] T4: Apply for building and electrical permits (1w) @Priya !high depends: T2, T3
- [ ] M1: Permits approved depends: T4

## P2: Design and procurement
> Lock in design decisions and order long-lead materials.

- [ ] T5: Select cabinets, countertops, fixtures, and finishes (1w) @Jordan depends: T2
- [ ] T6: Place orders for cabinets (1d) @Priya depends: T5, M1
- [ ] T7: Place orders for countertops (1d) @Priya depends: T5, M1
- [ ] T8: Order electrical materials and fixtures (2d) @Priya depends: T5, M1
- [ ] M2: Materials ordered depends: T6, T7, T8

## P3: Demolition and site preparation
> Remove existing kitchen components and prepare for construction.

- [ ] T9: Clear kitchen and protect adjacent areas (1d) @Jordan depends: M2
- [ ] T10: Demolish existing cabinets and countertops (3d) @Jordan depends: T9
- [ ] T11: Remove outdated electrical components as needed (2d) @Jordan depends: T10
- [ ] M3: Site ready for installation depends: T11

## P4: Electrical and infrastructure work
> Complete required wiring upgrades before finishes are installed.

- [ ] T12: Install new wiring and electrical circuits (1w) @Jordan !high depends: M3
- [ ] T13: Schedule rough-in inspection (1d) @Priya depends: T12
- [ ] T14: Pass rough-in inspection (1d) @Priya !high depends: T13
- [ ] M4: Electrical work approved depends: T14

## P5: Cabinet and countertop installation
> Build the permanent kitchen structure.

- [ ] T15: Install new cabinets (1w) @Jordan depends: M4, T6
- [ ] T16: Measure and template countertops (1d) @Jordan depends: T15
- [ ] T17: Install countertops (3d) @Jordan depends: T16, T7
- [ ] M5: Major fixtures installed depends: T17

## P6: Finishes and final inspection
> Complete remaining work and obtain final approval.

- [ ] T18: Install lighting, outlets, and electrical fixtures (3d) @Jordan depends: M5, T8
- [ ] T19: Complete finish work and adjustments (3d) @Jordan depends: T18
- [ ] T20: Conduct final cleanup and punch-list review (2d) @Jordan depends: T19
- [ ] T21: Schedule final inspection (1d) @Priya depends: T20
- [ ] T22: Pass final inspection (1d) @Priya !high depends: T21
- [ ] T23: Close out budget and document actual costs (1d) @Priya depends: T22
- [ ] M6: Kitchen remodel complete depends: T23
